sections.related_work: LLM Review: Enhancing Creative Writing via Blind Peer Review Feedback~\cite{arxiv260108003} is closely related to our setting. AlphaIdeaBench: Benchmarking Automated Research Idea Generation under Feasibility Constraints with Peer Review Alignment~\cite{arxiv261033644} is closely related to our setting. Can AI Be a Good Peer Reviewer? A Survey of Peer Review Process, Evaluation, and the Future~\cite{arxiv260427924} is closely related to our setting. Other relevant lines of work include AgentReview: Exploring Peer Review Dynamics with LLM Agents~\cite{arxiv240612708}, A Vision for Auto Research with LLM Agents~\cite{arxiv250418765}, LitReview Arena: Evaluating Literature Review Agents with Battle-Style Peer Review Platform~\cite{arxiv260821374}, Agentic Tool Use in Large Language Models~\cite{arxiv260400835}, Retrieval-Augmented Code Generation: A Survey with Focus on Repository-Level Approaches~\cite{arxiv251004905}.
